entry.title: security: remove guest cookie, add session hardening, CSRF, lockout
entry.content:
security: remove guest cookie, add session hardening, CSRF, lockout

ARCHITECTURAL CHANGES:
- Remove guest cookie system — guest mode is now client-side only
  - Eliminates auth bypass via forged hifz_guest=1 cookie
  - All API routes use simple getSessionUser() null check
  - Guest button on login page still works (client localStorage)
- Add per-account lockout: 5 failed attempts = 15-minute lock
- Add sliding session expiration: refresh cookie every 1 hour
- Add session revocation: login invalidates all old sessions
- Reject sessions created before last password change
- Harden scrypt: N=65536, r=8, p=1 (was using Node defaults)
- Add CSRF protection: reject cross-origin POST/PUT/DELETE to API routes
- Add @@index([verseKey]) to ReviewLog
- Add @@index([pageNumber]) to Verse

SCHEMA CHANGES:
- User: +lastPasswordChangedAt, +failedLoginAttempts, +lockedUntil
- Session: +lastRefreshAt

entry.title: security: harden CSP, rate-limit APIs, auth on tajweed, input validation
entry.content:
security: harden CSP, rate-limit APIs, auth on tajweed, input validation

CRITICAL:
- next@16.3.3→16.3.4 (patches CVE-2025-66478 RCE, CVE-2026-44573, CVE-2026-64641)
- Remove unsafe-eval from CSP script-src

HIGH:
- Rate limit ALL API routes (read: 60/min, write: 30/min, expensive: 10/min)
- Add auth check to /api/tajweed (was unauthenticated paid API proxy)
- Add batch size limit (100) to /api/reviews/sync
- Add base-uri, form-action, frame-ancestors, object-src, upgrade-insecure-requests to CSP

MEDIUM:
- Add grade validation to /api/reviews/sync (prevents data corruption)
- Add MIME type validation on tajweed audio upload
- Sanitize error messages (no internal details leaked to client)
- Pin wildcard CSP domains to exact subdomains (prevent subdomain takeover)
